intro: Major Samuelson is a high-ranking officer in the Stormwind City Guard stationed within the throne room of Stormwind Keep. As an experienced military commander, he oversees vital personnel matters and previously mentored junior officers such as Lieutenant Farren Orinelle.

p: Standing within Stormwind Keep before the royal court, Major Samuelson represents the leadership of the Stormwind City Guard. He oversees officer postings and administrative military orders across the realm. Notably, he mentored Lieutenant Farren Orinelle, an officer stationed far north at Southshore in the Hillsbrad Foothills. When junior commanders find themselves overwhelmed or seeking transfer from distant frontier garrisons, their requests and official reports travel directly across the kingdom to Major Samuelson's desk in the capital.
